Headroom is not uniform and the reason is on the record. The tree's own
zig-out binary was rebuilt three times while these were being set, by the
three lanes in gather.zig / bench.zig / plumb.py tonight. picosoc and
spimemio never moved. simpleuart read 86.7% on the arm and 87.6% on the
18:41 tree; picorv32 read 59.4% and 58.3%. So the picorv32 row carries a
point and a half and the rest carry half a point, and that asymmetry
retires the day gather.zig settles - raise it back then, in a commit that
says so. A 1.1-point swing on one file and a 0.9-point swing the other way
on another, from one binary, is the trade this file exists to show.
Tree-sitter reads 98.8% on picorv32's bytes. That is what these are for:
no column on the board is computed from anything but our own tree, so a
token nobody stood on was invisible for the life of the project.
__floor: `source` is repo-root-relative and may be absent from a given checkout —
an absent source skips loudly rather than passing, since a check that goes
green when its input is missing is a check that reports on the machine.
A row with no `source` is the grammar's corpus specimen.
